items.text: Fixed shears causing blood effects when hitting a sheep.
Fixed magazines staying invisible after swapping weapons mid‑reload.
Fixed binoculars screen effect not working when domain reload is disabled.
Fixed deep sea water height update that copied the whole texture, dropping a 256 MB allocation and preventing major client crashes.
Fixed biofuel generator snapping to the wrong spot in corners with advanced snapping.
Fixed placing/destroying doors refreshing all doors on the server; now only the modified door updates.
Fixed players getting stuck in computer stations when the space behind the chair is blocked; added extra dismount points and toast notifications for refused dismounts.
Food spawned in loot containers no longer spoils until the container is looted or the item is removed; exposed as an option on the container entity.
Adjusted Uzi drops in hackable crates to avoid overlapping spawns and tweaked weight to limit dilution; elite and underwater‑lab crates retain their spawn behavior but now include ammo.
Fixed patrol helicopter rocket deaths to correctly show the helicopter on the death screen and attribute kills to the heli.
Added Uzi loot spawns and introduced hackable, elite, and underwater variants of the normal crate.
Prevented shore ice from spawning over railway tracks by adding a rail terrain filter.
Fixed roadside waterpipes spawning on top of roads at T‑junctions by excluding road topology in the spawn filter.
Added a combat log entry when hitting gull groups.
Corrected phone conversation UI to display proper information after server commands are used.
Fixed a null‑reference crash when opening the inventory screen while in a phone conversation.
Fixed drop‑item keybinds so they no longer unintentionally drop the held belt item while the inventory is open.
Turrets now always use the stock's extended properties, regardless of how the stock is set.
Extended triangular prism splash‑damage bounds to include grills and triangle hatches, with slight adjustments to hatch bounds.
Fixed a null‑reference error in PlayerBoat.UpdateWake after rejoining a server, ensuring destroyed boats are properly removed from the FX queue.
Fixed a prefab syntax error that could cause structures to fail to load or behave incorrectly.
Food spawned in loot containers no longer spoils until the container is looted or the item is removed.
Uzi loot spawns in hackable, elite, and underwater crates have been rebalanced with improved positions and weight distribution.
Door placement and destruction now refresh only the modified door, avoiding unnecessary server-wide updates.
Biofuel generators snap correctly when using advanced corner snapping.
Players no longer get stuck in computer stations; extra dismount points and notifications have been added for blocked exits.
Opening inventory during a phone conversation no longer crashes, and the phone UI now displays correct information after server commands.
Binoculars screen effect works even when domain reload is disabled.
Patrol helicopter rocket kills now correctly show the helicopter on the death screen.
Turrets consistently apply the weapon’s stock extended properties, ensuring reliable performance regardless of stock configuration.
Deployable splash damage now includes grills and triangle hatches for consistent damage to those structures.
Combat log entries now record hits on gull groups and use short weapon names for clearer information.
Shore ice and waterpipes no longer spawn on top of railways and roads, eliminating visual glitches and movement issues.

2026-11-03.summary:
### Loot & Resources
- Food spawned in loot containers no longer spoils until the container is looted or the item is removed.
- Uzi loot spawns in hackable, elite, and underwater crates have been rebalanced with improved positions and weight distribution.

### Base Building
- Door placement and destruction now refresh only the modified door, avoiding unnecessary server-wide updates.
- Biofuel generators snap correctly when using advanced corner snapping.

### Interaction & UI
- Players no longer get stuck in computer stations; extra dismount points and notifications have been added for blocked exits.
- Opening inventory during a phone conversation no longer crashes, and the phone UI now displays correct information after server commands.
- Binoculars screen effect works even when domain reload is disabled.
- Patrol helicopter rocket kills now correctly show the helicopter on the death screen.

### Combat & Damage
- Turrets consistently apply the weapon’s stock extended properties, ensuring reliable performance regardless of stock configuration.
- Deployable splash damage now includes grills and triangle hatches for consistent damage to those structures.
- Combat log entries now record hits on gull groups and use short weapon names for clearer information.

### World & Environment
- Shore ice and waterpipes no longer spawn on top of railways and roads, eliminating visual glitches and movement issues.

items.text: Fixed CH‑47 cargo crates getting stuck on powerline poles at the powerplant.
Reduced boat groups spawned at large oil rigs from two to one, easing traffic and spawn congestion.
PT‑boat turret aim cone widened and damage reduced, with front turret now using standard crosshair.
UZI now consumes double the condition per use, affecting its durability.

Birds and gulls receive stronger obstacle avoidance, better walking step handling, reduced startle radius, and corpses now inherit velocity; shooting distance calculations fixed and missing seagull points added.
New gliding behavior, far‑range flee response, higher circling for crows, and deep‑sea gull spawning improve wildlife dynamics.
Splash effect timing unified across buoyancy points and minimum interval lowered, preventing audio cut‑outs during storms.
Fixed null reference exception when destroying phone objects, preventing crashes.

2026-11-02.summary:
### Transport
- Fixed CH‑47 cargo crates getting stuck on powerline poles at the powerplant.
- Reduced boat groups spawned at large oil rigs from two to one, easing traffic and spawn congestion.

### Combat
- PT‑boat turret aim cone widened and damage reduced, with front turret now using standard crosshair.
- UZI now consumes double the condition per use, affecting its durability.

### AI & Wildlife
- Birds and gulls receive stronger obstacle avoidance, better walking step handling, reduced startle radius, and corpses now inherit velocity; shooting distance calculations fixed and missing seagull points added.
- New gliding behavior, far‑range flee response, higher circling for crows, and deep‑sea gull spawning improve wildlife dynamics.

### Audio & Effects
- Splash effect timing unified across buoyancy points and minimum interval lowered, preventing audio cut‑outs during storms.

### Stability
- Fixed null reference exception when destroying phone objects, preventing crashes.

items.text: Ice Lake placement rebalanced: larger ice lakes now spawn more often and anchors are used more sparsely, resulting in more varied lake distribution across new maps.
Fixed livestock getting stuck in loops or pausing when being led, especially in tight corridors or when many animals are present.

2026-11-01.summary:
### World Generation
- Ice Lake placement rebalanced: larger ice lakes now spawn more often and anchors are used more sparsely, resulting in more varied lake distribution across new maps.

### Animals & AI
- Fixed livestock getting stuck in loops or pausing when being led, especially in tight corridors or when many animals are present.
